_comment: Board #2930 follow-up (2026-09-05). Judgement-call land-region merges: the region owning anchor_a is force-unioned into the region owning anchor_b regardless of any drawn magenta line between them (Chris: 'unify regardless of lines'). Anchors are canvas-pixel coordinates copied from the naming worksheet's own anchor_x/anchor_y columns at the time each merge was decided (land_regions_worksheet.csv, generated by mapgen/render_land_regions_preview.py). Consumed by mapgen/generate_provinces.py via worldgen.land_provinces.apply_land_region_merges, applied after the region stage's own flood-fill/merge-floor/island-override machinery. Region ids/numbers shift on every regen (Hilbert-renumbered) so this file identifies regions by physical location, never by their transient STATE_LAND_NNN id.

merges.note: re-added 2026-09-29 (#1): west Drakwald lobe (625) into the Marienburg pocket (628)
2026-09-29 (#15): Eldagrimm spur (state 44's SW peninsula tip), cut off only by the dilated coast paint, back into state 44
